Method of Attack: Encrypts files including executables in targeted folders using AES-128 encryption
Renames encrypted files by appending .exotic extension
Targets specific user folders such as Desktop, Downloads, MyMusic, MyVideos, Contacts, MyPictures, Personal, and %UserProfile%
Downloads and displays a lock screen image from http://mitteoderso.de/image.png
Terminates certain processes (taskmgr, cmd, procexp, procexp64, regedit, CCleaner64, msconfig)
Monitors targeted folders for new unencrypted files and encrypts them
Shuts down the computer when timer reaches zero
Copies itself to startup folder but becomes encrypted and inactive on reboot
Impacted Systems: Windows user profile folders including Desktop, Downloads, MyMusic, MyVideos, Contacts, MyPictures, Personal, %UserProfile% folder
Attack Vector: Infection via execution on victim's computer targeting user profile folders
